normalizedStatement: WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_owner", "p_refresh" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_owner" uuid, "p_refresh" boolean) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "api"."request_collection_valuation"("p_owner" := pgrst_body."p_owner", "p_refresh" := pgrst_body."p_refresh") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "request_collection_valuation".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "request_collection_valuation"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
limitations: Historical aggregate, not matched before/after or per-account cold/warm.
p_refresh is a bind parameter, so GET(false) and explicit refresh(true) cannot be separated.
Includes SQL execution and waiting represented by pg_stat_statements; excludes client/network/render timing.
No valuation RPC, price refresh, EXPLAIN ANALYZE or application job executed by this inspection.
Function evaluates collection inputs and updates generation metadata; representative safe local plans are required before any DB rewrite/index proposal.
